candidates.change_summary: Change final return value from true to false, so successful non-reverting calls now return false.
Return the success flag of the last external call instead of constant true, causing return value to depend on last call result.
Return logical AND of all external call success flags instead of constant true, so any non-failing but false success influences return.

Change the call target selector to transfer(address,address,uint256) so external contract receives different 'from' argument position (swapped first two params), altering observable effects of external calls.
Use transferFrom with amount zero (v set to 0) when calling external contract, changing transferred value observed by external contracts.
Invert the success check to revert on success and continue on failure, changing whether external failures abort the transfer.
